Complete repair agent including local online retrieval and four text calls of 2000 input/500 output tokens per request. Fixed 8B answer/embedding models and 9 TB corpus. Excludes offline refresh, separately allocated.

sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. This is an early planning view based on accepted assumptions. Treat it as a starting point for discussion, not a production promise.

The workload estimate is 16 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 16 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 16 to 24). HGX_B200: 24 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 16 to 32). HGX_H200: 32 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 32 to 48). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The factory-size estimate and the chosen deployment anchor describe different things. Spare room exists but does not mean a customer is ready to use it.

Required memory per GPU: 80 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 4096 GB. Host local disk provision: 61440 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. Each GPU must hold enough working memory for the job. Host memory and local disk are planning assumptions, so confirm them with the architect.

Declared local storage tiers: object 29500000000000 usable bytes. Storage capacity alone does not establish storage throughput or a vendor choice. Files kept for later have declared room, but room alone does not show how fast they can be read or written. Transfer speed still needs measurement.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. Traffic entering the factory and links between GPUs are still open questions. Treat missing figures as work to do, not as empty demand.
